source.content: public virtual class DomainRecord { public String name; public virtual String label() { return name; } }
public class AccountRecord extends DomainRecord implements NamedRecord { public override String label() { return 'Account:' + name; } }
public class RecordFactory { public static AccountRecord account(String name) { AccountRecord record = new AccountRecord(); record.name = name; return record; } }
public class RecordSelector { public NamedRecord first() { return RecordFactory.account('Acme'); } }
public class RecordService { public String summarize() { NamedRecord record = new RecordSelector().first(); return record.label(); } }
public class RecordJob { public static String run() { return new RecordService().summarize(); } }
@isTest private class RecordServiceTest { @isTest static void summarizes() { System.assertEquals('Account:Acme', RecordJob.run()); } }
